gloss: young boy (polite); son (someone else's); pampered boy

definitions.gloss: young boy; son (of someone else, polite)
definitions.explanation: A polite term used to address or refer to someone else's young son or a young boy in general.

definitions.gloss: pampered boy; sheltered young man; rich kid
definitions.explanation: A young man who has been raised in comfort and lacks worldly experience. Often implies naivety or being spoiled.

examples.japanese: {坊|ぼ}っちゃん、⟦おいくつ→おいくつ：28149_oikutsu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How old are you, young man?

examples.japanese: お⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{坊|ぼ}っちゃん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear the neighbor's boy started elementary school this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{坊|ぼ}っちゃん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}して→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧きたらしい。
examples.english: Apparently, the company president's son has joined the firm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{坊|ぼ}っちゃん⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He was raised as a pampered boy and doesn't know hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{坊|ぼ}っちゃんだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{庶民|しょみん}→庶民：12427_shomin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧んだろう。
examples.english: He's a rich kid from a good family, so he probably doesn't understand how ordinary people live.

examples.japanese: {坊|ぼ}っちゃん{気質|かたぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{世間知|せけんし}らず→世間知らず：22674_sekenshirazu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He's said to have a sheltered temperament and be ignorant of the world.

notes:
{坊|ぼ}っちゃん comes from {坊|ぼう} (boy, monk) with the diminutive/affectionate ちゃん suffix. The っ is a phonetic change.

Sense 1 is a polite, respectful term for someone else's son. Sense 2 often carries an ironic or critical tone, suggesting the person is naive or spoiled.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {坊|ぼ}っちゃん⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧ (raised as a pampered child)
- {坊|ぼ}っちゃん{気質|かたぎ} (sheltered temperament)
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{坊|ぼ}っちゃん (boy from a well-off family)

The word is also famous as the title of Natsume Soseki's novel 「{坊|ぼ}っちゃん」(1906).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{嬢|じょう}さん→お嬢さん：01566_ojousan⟧: young lady, daughter (the female equivalent)
